lrc:
[00:00.00]基督的爱 是何等长阔高深
[00:03.03]并知道这爱 是过于人所能测度的
[00:06.35]便叫神一切所充满的 充满了你们
[00:33.77]祢流出宝血
[00:39.83]洗净我污秽
[00:43.02]将我的生命赎回
[00:48.81]祢为了我的罪
[00:52.58]牺牲永不悔
[00:55.95]显明祢极大恩惠
[01:03.04]我深深体会
[01:06.03]祢爱的宝贵
[01:09.33]献上自己永追随
[01:15.59]或伤心或气馁
[01:19.02]或生离或死别
[01:22.38]愿刚强壮胆永远不后退
[01:28.01]哦 祢爱永不变
[01:32.31]从今直到永远
[01:35.82]深深浇灌我心田
[01:42.45]或天旋或地转
[01:45.39]经沧海历桑田
[01:48.81]都不能叫我与祢爱隔绝

syncSegmentsEn.text: How long and wide and high and deep is the love of Christ
May you know this love that surpasses all understanding
That you may be filled with all the fullness of God
You shed Your precious blood
To wash away my stains
And redeem my life
For my sins
You gave Yourself without regret
Revealing Your boundless grace
I know deep in my heart
How precious Your love is
I give myself to follow You forever
Whether heartbroken or discouraged
Whether parted in life or parted by death
May I stand strong and courageous and never draw back
Oh, Your love never changes
From now until forever
It waters the deepest soil of my heart
Though the heavens reel and the earth turns over
Though seas turn to fields with the passing of ages
Nothing can separate me from Your love
